correctness.rationale: An exhaustive integer face-poset construction enumerates 2316 nonempty faces. The 1148-pair vertex-toggle matching passes a global acyclicity test, with one 0-cell, four 3-cells, fifteen 4-cells. A fully reconstructed signed Morse 4-by-15 boundary has a 4-by-4 minor of determinant +1; the resulting CW model is a wedge of eleven four-spheres. Independent mod-two simplicial ranks are (17,109,326,448,216,36). The flag-complex support lemma proves the 10-vertex minimum. Exactly nine induced 5K2 graphs survive complete graph-edge enumeration; their integral join cycles have zero boundary and raise the rank of the mod-two boundary-plus-cycle matrix from 216 to 225. All 18 signed simplicial symmetry traces and the positive reflection orientation are recomputed. The formula is for this finite graph, not an extrapolation.

value.rationale: GP(9,3) is a canonical exceptional generalized Petersen cubic graph with ninefold symmetry and three inner triangles. The induced 4-sphere support bound 10 is intrinsically sharp for any flag complex; the complete nine-support orbit is thus canonical, not an arbitrarily selected subfamily. These smallest spheres account for only rank nine in a rank-eleven integral fourth homology group. The missing rational classes form the irreducible two-dimensional D9 module factoring through D3, furnishing a natural, previously unprovided symmetry explanation for the failure of smallest carriers to generate. This complete finite exact calculation supplies intrinsic homotopy, support, and full automorphism data unavailable from Euler characteristic or face numbers alone. It makes no unsupported infinite-family claim.
